app.title: MCServer
server_list.title: Servers
server_list.subtitle: {status} · {memory}
server_list.empty: No servers yet. Create one, or import a folder you already have.
server_list.error.load: The server list couldn't be loaded. The configuration file may be damaged or from a newer MCServer version. Details are in MCServer's log (Settings › Help).
server_details.error.gone: This server no longer exists. Refresh the list to see the current servers.
server_details.error.load: This server's details couldn't be loaded. Details are in MCServer's log (Settings › Help).
welcome.title: Welcome to MCServer
welcome.text: Select a server in the list on the left.
welcome.first: Run and manage Minecraft Java servers on this PC. Create a server from a Paper or Vanilla download, or import a server folder you already have.
dashboard.hint.java_missing: Java was not found, so servers can't be started. Install Java and restart MCServer.
dashboard.hint.other_running: Stop {server_id} first: MCServer runs one server at a time.
dashboard.hint.running: Stopping sends the stop command and waits for the server to save.
dashboard.notice.stopped_unexpectedly: {server_id} stopped unexpectedly. Check the console for details.
dashboard.success.created: {server_id} was created. Press Start when you're ready.
dashboard.open_folder_failed: Couldn't open {path}. The folder may not exist yet.
console.title: Console
console.input.disabled: Commands can be sent while the server is running
console.unavailable: The console is unavailable because Java was not found.
errors.another_server_running: {server_id} is already running. Stop it before starting another server.
errors.start_failed: {server_id} couldn't be started. Details has the technical information.
errors.stop_failed: MCServer couldn't confirm that {server_id} stopped. It may still be running; check Task Manager for java.exe before starting it again. Details has the technical information.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Details has the technical information.
errors.server_id_taken: A server with the ID {server_id} already exists. Choose another ID.
errors.directory_in_use: The folder {directory} is already used by {server_id}. Choose another folder.
errors.directory_exists: A folder named {directory} already exists in the servers folder. Its files were not changed; choose another folder name.
errors.jar_exists: {directory} already contains {jar_file}; it was not overwritten.
errors.invalid_source_jar: The selected file can't be used: {reason}.
errors.provisioning_failed: The server files couldn't be prepared. Nothing was kept from this attempt.
errors.storage_failed: MCServer couldn't save the server list. Nothing was created.
errors.provisioning_rollback_failed: Creating {server_id} failed and some files could not be cleaned up: {leftovers}. You can delete them manually.
errors.creation_rollback_failed: Creating {server_id} failed and cleanup was incomplete: its configuration may still be listed. Files left on disk: {leftovers}. Check the details below and remove what is left manually.
create.title: Create a server
create.subtitle: Pick a name, the server software and how much memory it gets.
create.server_id.label: Name
create.server_id.hint: Shown in the server list. Letters, numbers, spaces and dashes.
create.directory.label: Folder name
create.directory.hint: Created inside the servers folder. Follows the name unless you change it.
create.source_jar.label: Server software
create.source_jar.hint: Paper is fast and supports plugins. Vanilla is Minecraft exactly as Mojang releases it.
create.memory_mb.label: Memory
create.progress: Creating the server folder and copying the JAR. This can't be cancelled once it has started.
create.error.server_id_invalid: Use letters, numbers, spaces, dots or dashes; no \ / : * ? " < > | and no leading or trailing spaces.
create.error.server_id_taken: This ID is already used by another server.
create.error.directory_invalid: This folder name isn't allowed. Use a simple name without \ / : * ? " < > |.
create.error.directory_taken: This folder is already used by {server_id}.
create.error.jar_invalid: Choose a .jar file whose name has no special characters.
exit.confirm.title: Stop the server?
exit.confirm.text: {server_id} is still running. Stop it and exit MCServer?
exit.wait_for_operation: Please wait until the current operation finishes.
exit.stop_timed_out.title: The server is still stopping
exit.stop_timed_out.text: {server_id} didn't stop within {timeout} seconds. Keep waiting, kill it (changes since its last autosave can be lost), or cancel closing MCServer?
session.block_reason: MCServer is stopping your Minecraft server so that the world is saved.
dashboard.hint.starting: Waiting for the server to finish loading. It shows Running once players can join.
dashboard.hint.stop_timed_out: {server_id} hasn't finished stopping. Wait with Stop, or Kill it (changes since the last autosave can be lost).
dashboard.hint.stopping: The server is saving and shutting down.
dashboard.failure.start_timeout: {server_id} didn't finish starting in time, so MCServer asked it to stop (it was not killed). {hint}
dashboard.warning.java_requirement_unkno: MCServer can't verify which Java Minecraft {version} needs, so it started with Java {java_major}. If the server fails, install a newer Java.
dashboard.warning.java_outdated_allowed: Started with Java {java_major} although Java {required} is required; the server will probably fail.
hint.port_in_use: Another program is already using the server's port.
hint.java_too_old: This server needs a newer Java version.
hint.out_of_memory: The server ran out of memory or couldn't reserve it. Try less memory or close other programs.
hint.corrupt_jar: The server JAR looks damaged or unreadable. Replace it with a fresh download.
hint.unknown: See Details for the last console lines.
kill.confirm.title: Kill the server?
kill.confirm.text: Killing {server_id} ends it immediately without saving. Changes since its last autosave can be lost and a chunk being written can be damaged. Kill it anyway?
details.title: Technical details
console.input.placeholder: Type a command, e.g. say hello — ↑ ↓ for history
errors.eula_not_accepted: The Minecraft EULA hasn't been accepted for {server_id}.
errors.server_not_running: {server_id} isn't running, so the command wasn't sent.
errors.invalid_command: Enter a command on a single line.
errors.command_failed: The command couldn't be sent to {server_id}; it may be shutting down.
errors.java_not_found: No working Java was found, so the server can't start.
errors.java_too_old: {server_id} needs Java {required}, but Java {found} was found.
errors.invalid_java: The selected file isn't a working Java: {executable}
errors.world_in_use: The world {world} of {server_id} is in use by another program, probably a server that is still running. Close it first.
errors.stop_timed_out: {server_id} didn't stop within {timeout} seconds and is still running. Press Stop to keep waiting, or Kill it.
errors.process_guard: {server_id} couldn't be started under MCServer's process protection, so it was not started at all.
eula.title: Accept the Minecraft EULA?
eula.text: To run {server_id}, you must accept the Minecraft End User License Agreement (EULA). Read it at https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA. Accept it and start the server?
create.eula.label: I have read and accept the Minecraft EULA
create.eula.hint: Minecraft servers may only run after accepting it: https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA
create.error.eula_required: Accept the Minecraft EULA to create the server.
java.dialog.title: Java is needed
java.missing.text: No working Java was found.{needed} Install a Java runtime, for example Eclipse Temurin (https://adoptium.net), then press Check again, or choose java.exe yourself.
java.needed: This server needs Java {required} or newer.
java.too_old.text: {server_id} needs Java {required}, but MCServer found Java {found} ({executable}). Install a newer Java (for example from https://adoptium.net), choose another java.exe, or start anyway (the server will probably fail).
unclean.title: {server_id} was not stopped cleanly
unclean.text: When MCServer last ended, {server_id} (started {started_at}) was still running, so it was terminated without saving. Changes since its last autosave (normally within about 5 minutes) may be lost, and a chunk being written may be damaged. Start the server and check the world before playing.
edit.title: Edit {server_id}
edit.display_name.label: Name
edit.display_name.hint: Shown in the server list. The server ID {server_id} never changes.
edit.memory.label: Memory
edit.jar.label: Server JAR
edit.jar.hint_running: Stop the server to choose another JAR.
edit.jvm.label: Extra Java arguments
edit.jvm.hint: Separated by spaces, for example -XX:+UseG1GC. Memory is set above.
edit.java.label: Java for this server
edit.note: Changes apply the next time the server starts.
delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.files: Also move its folder to the Recycle Bin
delete.files_hint: Without this, the folder {path} stays where it is and can be imported again later.
delete.done.kept: {name} was removed. Its folder was kept.
delete.done.recycle_bin: {name} was removed and its folder was moved to the Recycle Bin.
delete.done.trash: {name} was removed and its folder was moved to {location}.
delete.done.missing: {name} was removed; its folder no longer existed.
adopt.title: Import a server folder
adopt.subtitle: Use a server you already have. Its files are never moved or changed.
adopt.folder.label: Folder
adopt.inside: This folder is inside the servers folder, so it is used where it is.
adopt.outside: This folder will be copied into the servers folder; the original stays unchanged.
adopt.jar.label: Server JAR
adopt.no_jars: This folder has no .jar file, so it can't be imported.
adopt.server_id.label: Name
adopt.memory.label: Memory
settings.title: Settings
settings.java.missing: Java was not found. Install a Java runtime (for example Eclipse Temurin 21), then press Check again.
settings.stop_timeout.label: Stop timeout
settings.stop_timeout.hint: How long Stop waits for the server to save before Kill is offered.
settings.startup_timeout.label: Startup timeout
settings.startup_timeout.hint: How long a start may take before MCServer stops the server gracefully.
settings.language.label: Language
errors.files_removal_failed: The folder {directory} could be moved neither to the Recycle Bin nor to the trash folder, so nothing was deleted. {reason}
properties.title: server.properties
properties.missing: server.properties is created when the server starts for the first time. Values you save now are used from the first start.
properties.saved_restart: server.properties was saved. Restart the server to apply the changes.
properties.invalid: Some values are not valid; they are marked below and nothing was saved.
backups.empty: No backups yet. A backup copies the world and settings; logs and caches are left out.
backups.schedule.enabled: Back up automatically while the server runs
backups.schedule.hint: Only scheduled backups are counted; older ones go to the Recycle Bin. Manual and before-restore backups are never removed automatically.
backups.schedule.saved: Automatic backups are on for this server.
backups.schedule.off: Automatic backups are off for this server.
backups.scheduled_created: Scheduled backup {backup_id} of {server_id} was created; {removed} older scheduled backup(s) moved to the Recycle Bin.
backups.working: Working… This can take a while for large worlds.
backups.restored: Backup {backup_id} was restored. The previous state was saved as {safety_id}.
backups.deleted: Backup {backup_id} was moved to the Recycle Bin.
backups.restore_running: Stop the server to restore a backup.
backups.restore.title: Restore {backup_id}?
backups.restore.text: The world and settings of {name} will be replaced with this backup. MCServer first saves the current state as a new backup, and the replaced files go to the Recycle Bin. Continue?
backups.restore.confirm_text: {name} will be set back to {created_at}. Restore now?
backups.delete.title: Delete {backup_id}?
backups.delete.text: The backup file will be moved to the Recycle Bin.
errors.server_port_in_use: Port {port} is already used by another program, probably another Minecraft server. Stop it or change server-port in Properties.
errors.invalid_properties: Some server.properties values are not valid.
errors.backup_not_possible: {server_id} is starting or stopping. Try again when it is running or stopped.
catalog.title: Download a server
catalog.subtitle: Official files only: Paper from PaperMC, Vanilla from Mojang. Each file is checked against its published checksum before it is used.
catalog.type.label: Server type
catalog.type.hint: Paper runs plugins and is faster; Vanilla is the unmodified game.
catalog.version.label: Minecraft version
catalog.java_unknown: The required Java version is not published for this version.
catalog.experimental_build: The newest Paper build of this version is experimental.
errors.catalog_unavailable: The server list could not be loaded: {reason}. Check the internet connection.
errors.download_failed: {file_name} could not be downloaded: {reason}. Nothing was kept.
worlds.column.name: World
worlds.current: The server loads {name}. Switching takes effect on the next start.
worlds.current_new: The server generates a new world {name} on its next start.
worlds.empty: No worlds yet. The server creates its world on the first start.
worlds.stop_to_switch: Stop the server to switch or create worlds.
worlds.working: Working… Large worlds take a while.
worlds.used: {name} is now the current world. It is loaded on the next start.
worlds.created: The new world {name} is generated on the next start.
worlds.imported: {name} was imported. Choose "Use this world" to play it.
worlds.deleted: {name} was moved to the Recycle Bin.
worlds.new.title: New world
worlds.new.name: Name of the new world:
worlds.new.seed: Seed (leave empty for a random world):
worlds.import.title: Import world
worlds.import.name: Name for the imported world:
worlds.import_folder.title: Choose a world folder (with level.dat)
worlds.import_zip.title: Choose a world ZIP file
worlds.export.title: Export world
worlds.delete.title: Delete {name}?
worlds.delete.text: The world {name} and its Nether and End folders will be moved to the Recycle Bin.
errors.world_exists: This server already has a folder named {name}. Choose another name.
errors.world_is_active: {name} is the current world. Switch to another world first, or make a backup to copy it while the server runs.
errors.invalid_world_name: {name} cannot be used as a world name. Use letters, digits, - and _, and do not end it with _nether or _the_end.
dashboard.hint.auto_restarting: The server crashed. It starts again automatically in {delay} s (attempt {attempt} of {limit}).
dashboard.hint.auto_restart_gave_up: The server crashed {limit} times within 10 minutes, so it was not started again. Check the details before starting it.
dashboard.notice.auto_restarted: Started again automatically after a crash (attempt {attempt} of {limit}).
dashboard.no_logs: This server has no logs folder yet; it is created on the first start.
console.save_failed: The console log could not be saved to {path}.
settings.auto_restart.label: Restart a server automatically after a crash
settings.auto_restart.hint: At most 3 times within 10 minutes. A server you stop or kill, or one that does not finish starting, is never restarted.
settings.language.later: The language changes after open pages and running operations finish, or after restarting MCServer.
progress.cancelling: Cancelling… Removing what was written so far.
progress.cancelled: Cancelled. Nothing was kept from the unfinished operation.
progress.stage.saving_world: Asking the server to save the world…
first_run.title: Welcome to MCServer
first_run.java.title: Java
first_run.java.intro: Minecraft servers run on Java. MCServer does not include it; it finds the Java installed on this PC. Minecraft 1.20.5 and newer need Java 21 or newer.
first_run.java.missing: No Java was found. Install a Java runtime (for example Eclipse Temurin 21), then press Check again, or choose java.exe yourself. You can also do this later.
first_run.java.unknown: Java cannot be checked here. MCServer looks for it when a server starts.
first_run.folder.title: Servers folder
first_run.folder.intro: Each server gets its own folder here, next to MCServer's settings and backups:
first_run.folder.hint: Server folders kept elsewhere can be imported later: folders outside this one are copied, never moved.
first_run.create.title: Your first server
first_run.create.intro: Create a new server (MCServer can download Paper or Vanilla for you), or add a server folder you already have.
first_run.create.has_servers: Your servers are in the list on the left. You can add more at any time.
first_run.create.hint: This guide can be opened again from Settings › Help › Setup guide.
errors.server_not_found: {server_id} is no longer in the server list. It may have been removed outside MCServer; refresh the list.
errors.invalid_schedule: The backup schedule was not saved: back up every {min_hours}–{max_hours} hours and keep {min_keep}–{max_keep} backups.
settings.theme.label: Theme
settings.theme.hint: Automatic follows the Windows app mode.
settings.theme.later: The theme changes after open pages and running operations finish, or after restarting MCServer.
metrics.history_empty: No history yet; it builds up while the server runs.
metrics.history_memory: Memory over the last {minutes} minutes: {low}–{high} MB of {allocated} MB
memory.label: Memory
memory.recommended: This PC has {total} GB. Up to {maximum} GB can go to the server; the rest stays free for Windows.
memory.over: More than the {maximum} GB this PC can comfortably spare. Windows may slow down.
settings.subtitle: These apply to MCServer and every server in it.
settings.java.automatic_hint: MCServer finds Java on this PC by itself. Minecraft 1.20.5 and newer need Java 21.
settings.java.invalid: The chosen java.exe does not run. Choose another one or detect automatically.
settings.java.unknown: Java cannot be checked here; it is looked for when a server starts.
settings.setup_guide.label: Setup guide
settings.setup_guide.hint: Walks through Java, the servers folder and creating a first server.
dashboard.hint.stopped: Stopped. Press Start to let players join.
